definitions.explanation: A person who has graduated from university, or the educational background of holding a bachelor's degree. An abbreviation of {大学|だいがく}{卒業|そつぎょう}.

examples.japanese: {大卒|だいそつ}の{初任給|しょにんきゅう}はいくらですか。
examples.english: What is the starting salary for university graduates?

examples.japanese: この{会社|かいしゃ}は{大卒|だいそつ}{以上|いじょう}しか{採用|さいよう}しない。
examples.english: This company only hires people with at least a university degree.

examples.japanese: {日本|にほん}では{大卒|だいそつ}の{就職|しゅうしょく}{活動|かつどう}は{大学|だいがく}{三|さん}{年生|ねんせい}から{始|はじ}まる。
examples.english: In Japan, job hunting for university graduates starts in the third year of college.

notes:
Abbreviation of {大学|だいがく}{卒業|そつぎょう} (university graduation). One of the most common abbreviations seen in job listings and discussions about education and employment in Japan.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {大卒|だいそつ}{以上|いじょう} — university degree or above (job requirement)
- {大卒|だいそつ}{初任給|しょにんきゅう} — starting salary for university graduates
- {大卒|だいそつ}{採用|さいよう} — hiring of university graduates
- {大卒|だいそつ}{程度|ていど} — university-level (in civil service exams)

RELATED WORDS:
- {高卒|こうそつ} — high school graduate
- {院卒|いんそつ} — graduate school graduate
- {新卒|しんそつ} — new graduate (fresh out of school)
- {既卒|きそつ} — past graduate (already graduated but not yet employed)
